rows.traditional: A 同 B 差唔多
rows.jyutping: A tung4 B caa1 m4 do1
rows.note: Use A 同 B 差唔多 as the all-purpose colloquial choice when two things are broadly alike or about equal.

example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 nei5 go3 daap3 on3 caa1 m4 do1

rows.note: Use 等於 when one thing is exactly equivalent to or has the same value as another.

example.english: Ten ten-dollar bills correspond to one hundred dollars.
example.traditional: 十張十蚊紙等於一百蚊。
example.jyutping: sap6 zoeng1 sap6 man1 zi2 dang2 jyu1 jat1 baak3 man1

rows.note: Use 同 A 寫信 for an ongoing exchange of postal letters with someone.

example.english: I still correspond with my former pen pal by letter.
example.traditional: 我仲同以前嗰個筆友寫信。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 tung4 ji5 cin4 go2 go3 bat1 jau5 se2 seon3

rows.note: Use 同 A 傳訊息 when the correspondence consists of ongoing electronic messages rather than letters.

example.english: I correspond with my younger sister by text every day.
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 tung4 aa3 mui6 cyun4 seon3 sik1
